title: Lando Calrissian
description: LANDO CALRISSIAN is a smuggler, gambler, con artist and "all-around scoundrel" in the words of Han Solo — who knows the type well. Calrissian gambled his way to the position of adminIstrator of Cloud City of Bespin, where Han and Princess Leia seek his help in their escape from Darth Vader. Forced to betray his friend, Lando turns on the Empire. He is recruited into the Rebel Alliance and helps rescue Han and defeat the Imperial forces.
